independentWork: A has 3 odd and 5 even elements. An odd subset sum requires selecting 1 or 3 odd elements. With one odd element there are C(3,1)·2^5=96 subsets, excluding the three singleton subsets leaves 93. With all three odd elements there are C(3,3)·2^5=32 subsets, all satisfying n(X)≥2. Total 93+32=125.
